summary: No blocking defects found in T-002. The DAO aggregate query now preserves NULL semantics for enriched nutrients (AC-014), projection placement is aligned with architecture, and repository recomputation paths propagate enriched totals into daily summaries. Overall verdict: PASS WITH NOTES.

review_comments.message: Base macro fields are nullable in the projection even though the SQL in MealEntryDao uses COALESCE(SUM(...), 0.0), which guarantees non-null values for those four columns. This weakens type safety and can hide accidental SQL regressions.
review_comments.suggested_fix: Make kcalTotal/carbTotal/fatTotal/proteinTotal non-null Double in the projection, or remove COALESCE for those fields and keep nullable types consistently with explicit handling.

review_comments.message: Daily-summary recomputation logic was extended for enriched nutrients but remains duplicated in two repositories, increasing drift risk for future nutrient-field changes.
review_comments.suggested_fix: Extract shared recomputation into a common internal component/helper used by both repositories to keep future field mappings synchronized.

review_comments.message: Same duplication concern as LocalDiaryRepository; both code paths now carry identical enriched mapping and are easy to desynchronize.
review_comments.suggested_fix: Use one shared recalculation routine/service and call it from both repositories.

review_comments.message: DAO aggregation is well-covered, but the changed repository propagation path (MealEntryTotals -> DailySummaryEntity enriched fields) has no direct test coverage in this task, leaving a small regression gap for AC-009 behavior.
review_comments.suggested_fix: Add a focused repository-level test that mutates meals/fitness and asserts enriched fields persisted in DailySummaryEntity after recalc.

next.reason: Reviewer gate passes; proceed with QA/manual verification for AC-004/AC-009/AC-014 and optional follow-up test hardening on repository propagation.
